narrative.overview: The design system projects a high-discipline cybersecurity environment. It combines an authentic terminal boot atmosphere with sleek dark glassmorphism, dynamic matrix text scrambling, and glowing laser borders.
keyCharacteristics: Strict dark-mode palette rooted in pure void black and dark slate enclosures.
Monospace CLI accents for navigation, status indicators, and prompt text.
High-blur glassmorphic containers (backdrop-blur-2xl, backdrop-blur-xl) bounded by fine white glass borders (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)).
Interactive laser edge-glows and scramble text transitions on state change.

rules.name: The Green Rarity Rule
rules.body: Terminal Cyber Green (#1eff8e) is used on ≤5% of any given screen.

rules.name: The High Contrast Guardrail
rules.body: Body text must always maintain maximum contrast (#e2e8f0 over dark slate/black) without bright background flashes.

rules.name: The Monospace Scope Rule
rules.body: Monospace typography is strictly reserved for header pills, status labels, code badges, and terminal text.

rules.name: The Laser Spotlight Rule
rules.body: Cards remain subtle and dark at rest. Laser border highlights and radial light beams ignite strictly upon hover or focus.

dos: Do preserve dark mode strictly across all pages (color-scheme: dark, #000000 body background).
Do use ultra-fine 1px white glass borders (border-white/10 or rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)) to demarcate containers.
Do reserve monospace typography for navigation pills, terminal windows, labels, and status badges.
Do incorporate subtle scramble text glitches or laser spotlight glows on interactive element hover.
donts: Don't introduce bright white or light-colored full-page backgrounds.
Don't use solid saturated neon fills on buttons or cards; preserve translucent dark glass.
Don't mix non-monospace fonts inside terminal components or navigation pills.
Don't remove backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-2xl / backdrop-blur-xl) from floating content cards.
